# USC Trojans Gift Search: 12-Item Shortlist & Category Winners

### 1. Fanatics (`fanatics.com`)
* **Shipping Timing:** Items marked "Ready to Ship" typically process in 1 business day; standard domestic shipping takes 3–7 business days (free shipping promotions frequently available, e.g., code `39SHIP` on orders over $39).
* **Return Policy:** Industry-leading **365-day return window** from the ship date for unworn, unwashed items with original tags and labels. Returns can be dropped off via Happy Returns® (QR code, no box or printing required) or UPS. If returning for a refund to the original payment method using a pre-printed label or QR code, a return shipping fee of up to **$9.99** is deducted. Exchanges are supported within 60 days. Certain clearance items may carry final-sale designations.

### 2. USC Bookstore (`uscbookstore.com`)

Items marked "Sale" or "Clearance" are final sale. Customers cover return shipping to the Los Angeles distribution center.

Return Policy

USC Bookstore accepts returns of unworn, unwashed, undamaged and/or defective merchandise for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds will be made in the form of the original payment. All returned items must be accompanied by a return form.

DOWNLOAD RETURN FORM

Items shipped to USC Bookstore outside the returns window, not in new or gently used condition, without an invoice/return form, or not purchased at uscbookstore.com, may not be credited back or returned to you

Items shipped internationally are not returnable.

USC Bookstore Online Returns by Mail

Complete the Return Form including daytime telephone number and email address. For faster processing, please include a copy of the original invoice.
Package your return item in the original product box and USC Bookstore packaging (if available). You may also pack your return items in a well-padded envelope or box to prevent damage in transit.
Mail your return via the carrier of your choice (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, etc). We recommend that you keep copies of all paperwork in the event the package is lost or damaged in shipment (Note: We are not responsible for lost/misdirected packages.)
All shipping costs are NON-REFUNDABLE

Gift Cards / Final Sale Items

USC Bookstore Online Return to Store Locations
All store locations do not accept returns of merchandise originally purchased online.

USC Bookstore In-Store Purchases
USC Bookstore in-store purchases can be returned within 30 days of the date of purchases with a receipt at our store location. We do not accept mail returns for merchandise originally purchased at a retail location
